_comment: 'repo_file'/'repo_dir' come from the Hugging Face Hub -- our weights and the
benchmark assets we produced. 'gated' entries come from an MPI download portal
and need that site's account, which the downloader prompts for. 'url' entries

files.note: GRAFT without visual features (drop_vis_feats=True). This is the ablation checkpoint the paper reports, which is not the final checkpoint of that run.
SMPL-X body model. Register at https://smpl-x.is.tue.mpg.de; the downloader asks for those credentials.
Required only for the PROX benchmark, whose MoSh ground truth is male-gendered. Same archive and account as the neutral model.

SMPL-X kid shape template, required by smplfitter's BodyModel. Generated as zeros rather than downloaded: it only enters the mesh scaled by kid_factor, which GRAFT never sets, so its contents cannot affect any output. The real file is gated behind a separate AGORA registration, which this avoids.

NLF supplies GRAFT's per-frame initialisation. No account needed. This is the exact build the published numbers were produced with (md5 017838f287342f2fe95da5271919526c); other v0.3.2 builds load but do not reproduce the table.
The PROX empty-scene view GRAFT consumes as its second input.
Per-vertex weights for the V2S metric.
PROX scene depth. Loaded by the PROX context but not read by the metrics; kept so the loader stays unmodified.
Per-(sequence, camera) empty-scene views for RICH, 33 files. Ours, not RICH's.
